Today me and Jay went out looking for a creek he fished with his grandpa as a kid, we found it but it wasn't easy, we had to drive about an hour and trek through straight bush for about an hour to get to the first spot a couple sets of rapids on a pretty big creek, I caught one small brook trout about 11" or so, creek trout around here don't get too big so we kept it.(it's not the one in the picture), anyways the fishing there was really hard and we didn't get anymore bites, and the bugs were REALLY bad, mosquitos the size of small birds and the blackflies were out in full force too, we decided to pull out of there and decided to drive home the long way down a logging road that loops all the way around and comes back into town from the other end, and fish all the creeks on the road the way back, I caught the brook trout in the picture where the same creek we hiked into meets the road about 10kms up, I just dangled a spinner and a worm straight down into the culvert and it came and smashed it, didn't have much luck on any of the other small creeks until one spot I fish quite a bit that's near town on the other end, we pulled out 2 more small brookies and scared off 3 more, the trout aren't biting hot right now because there are some small moths hatching by the millions and the trout are hitting them. Anyways we got 3 small trout about 11"-12", and my bigger one was 15 and a half, I let Jay keep the 3 smalls and just took the big one, that way both of us get a meal out of our day.

Anyways we got back to town near the walleye spot at the walleye time so we ran into my place quick and grabbed minnows and some beans and weiners and a small cook stove and shit to make coffee and then we slammed walleye and ate dinner while catching fish.

Caught the big walleye right away, big girls 21" then we caught some 15's and a bunch of smalls.

It was a long and hard but good day out. I'm exhausted and probably going to bed soon.
